Overview

Fes is a city in Fès-Meknès with a population of 1,112,000. Morocco’s cultural and spiritual heart, home to the world’s oldest university and a beautifully preserved medieval medina. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
